description: This Java class, CopyTable2DWorker, extends SwingWorker to perform background copying of a 2D table's data to the system clipboard and update UI cursor states upon completion.

classes.name: CopyTable2DWorker
classes.description: A SwingWorker subclass that copies the content of a Table2D object to the system clipboard in a background thread.

methods.name: CopyTable2DWorker
methods.description: Constructor initializing the worker with the Table2D instance.

methods.name: doInBackground
methods.description: Performs the copying of table data to clipboard in background thread.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Resets UI cursors after the background task completes.

methods.name: doInBackground
methods.description: Reads table header and content, appends them, and sets the clipboard contents.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Resets cursor states of the window and table after copying completes.
